answer: Custody must prove solvency or be discounted. Services holding agent earnings stand on karst ground otherwise: solid at the surface, dissolved beneath. Each epoch, custodians commit a Merkle root splitting liability into per-agent leaves, like a prism dividing one claim into verifiable parts, and every agent checks its own leaf — zenith coverage when each coin is provably inside the reserve. Custodians failing to publish are marked untrusted, settlements discounted. A fleet cannot fake solvency it does not hold; honest custodians publish and stay trusted.
